note: Menu names, item labels, defaults and ranges are reconstructed from field familiarity with the W7220, NOT from Honeywell doc 63-2700. Every item needs checking against the manual in /docs. LCD labels are kept short like the real 2-line display but are not a copy of Honeywell artwork.
minPosNote: Damper output is 2-10 Vdc: 2 V = closed, 10 V = full open. Damper % = (V - 2) / 8 x 100. Actual OA airflow % is NOT linear with blade position, so verify min OA with a temperature-fraction or airflow measurement.

items.help: Outdoor conditions allow free cooling under the active strategy.
Damper is modulating for free cooling right now.
OCC input energized (or OCC set to ALWAYS). Unoccupied = damper closed except for free cooling.
Y1 call from the thermostat/unit controller into the JADE.
Y1 passed through to the unit for compressor stage 1.
Shows -- when no discharge sensor is wired.
Only with a Sylk enthalpy sensor (C7400S) on the OA.
Commanded actuator signal.
Feedback only from a Sylk (communicating) actuator. Non-communicating 2-10 V actuators show --.
Mixed air setpoint the damper modulates to during free cooling.
Below this OA temp, compressors are locked out.
Referential dry bulb changeover. OA below this = free cooling available. Hidden when an enthalpy sensor is detected.
Referential enthalpy changeover curve. Shown only with an OA enthalpy sensor.
CO2 level where DCV starts opening above minimum.
Occupied minimum damper position (no DCV).
Shown with DCV: minimum position for building-component ventilation.
Shown with DCV: position at full design occupancy.
Damper % where power exhaust stage 1 starts.
SYS = alarm output to thermostat / BAS.
Mixed air low limit. Below it, the damper is driven toward FREEZE POS.
Drives the damper to the configured minimum.
Drives the actuator full open (10 V).
Drives the actuator closed (2 V).
Energizes Y1-OUT to prove compressor stage 1.
Energizes Y2-OUT to prove compressor stage 2.

alarmCatalog.MA T SENS ERR: Mixed air sensor open/shorted or out of range.
alarmCatalog.OA SYLK T ERR: Sylk OA temperature sensor lost communication or reading invalid.
alarmCatalog.ACT ERROR: Sylk actuator not responding / stall detected.
alarmCatalog.FREEZE PROTECT: MAT below MA LO SET; damper driven to FREEZE POS.

strategyBySensors.note: JADE picks the strategy from which sensors it detects (auto-detected by polling the Sylk bus).
referential dry bulb: OA temp (C7250A or C7400S temp only)
